ops.text: USER DECISION (standing, supersedes the P4 spec's fallback clause): hand-maintained _native.pyi stubs are NOT acceptable — the stub must be machine-generated with a single source of truth (pyo3-stub-gen preferred; else our own introspection-based emitter over the built module; hand-maintenance is never the answer). Directive sent to the p4-api-r2 lane mid-flight: rework commit 338c2418 (feat(stubs): hand-maintained _native.pyi with a runtime drift gate), report what the pyo3-stub-gen spike actually found, and make the committed .pyi reproducible-by-command with the drift gate running that command. Lane state at directive time: adoption + rebase onto 96e68340 done (12 commits), fences rewritten, docs task in progress.
